tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no exceptions. This is paired with the recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere, no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. Its one paragraph says TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no exceptions. It also says this goes with the recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere, no exceptions.

The two project decisions behind it are "verification on all builds" (#22) and "https everywhere, no exceptions" (#25). #22 replaced an earlier decision (#20), which is retired, so the file doesn't mention it.

My first attempt to create the file through the shell failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the file tool instead. The Muninn session context also warned that 20 hook runs started and never finished. I didn't investigate that.
